title: PsychCounsel-Bench: Evaluating the Psychology Intelligence of Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on evaluating LLMs' knowledge of psychological counseling based on U.S. certification exam standards.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on evaluating the psychology intelligence of LLMs based on questions from the U.S. National Counselor Certification Exam, covering topics like counseling methods, abnormal psychology, and ethics.
